limitations: Chromium viewport/theme emulation, not a physical-device or reader comprehension study.

Citation URLs and their hit targets are checked against metadata without external navigation. Original-image navigation was checked in the preserved prior report and is not repeated.

CSS font/width checks do not replace actual screenshot review.

findings: All 10 open panels keep heading/close control, original quotation, marked translation, editor explanation and full source metadata legible without clipping or overlap.

Current Figure responses match saved image bytes; image/caption and exact native video seek/chapter passed. Original-image navigation and figure screenshot visual review refer to the preserved earlier evidence.
limitations: Current incremental run covers dark themes only; earlier light-theme checks belong to the preserved older candidates.
